lines.text: Your agent has USDC. But the site wants SOL. Or BONK. Or JUP.
Swapping takes a DEX, a wallet popup and a click. But an agent can't click.
That's why we built AgentSwap: swaps and payments made for agents. It builds the transaction through Jupiter, and your agent signs it. We never touch the keys.
Here is a real agent on mainnet. It asks for a quote. That part is free.
Then it asks for the swap. The server answers 402: one cent, in USDC.
Its x402 client pays, gets an unsigned transaction, signs it locally and sends it. No human in the loop.
Confirmed on Solscan: one USDC in, SOL out.
It's also an MCP server. Ask Claude how much BONK five USDC buys, or let Claude Code build your trading strategy on top of the API.
Next: our own liquidity pools, built for agent flow.
AgentSwap. Let your agent pay with whatever the world accepts. Plug it in today.
